fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires (lo <= hi)
  ensures ((result >= lo) and (result <= hi))
  ensures (((x < lo) or (x > hi)) or (result == x))
  ensures ((x >= lo) or (result == lo))
  ensures ((x <= hi) or (result == hi))
  effects pure
  example (clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5)
  example (clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0)
  example (clamp(15, 0, 10) == 10)
  example (clamp(0, 0, 10) == 0)
  example (clamp(10, 0, 10) == 10)
  example (clamp(4, 4, 4) == 4)
  example (clamp(-7, -5, -2) == -5)
{
  if (x < lo) then lo else if (x > hi) then hi else x
}

fn index_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, x)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result < len(xs)))
  ensures (xs[result] == x)
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] != x)
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 7, 9], 7) == 1)
  example (index_of([3, 3, 3], 3) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 2], 2) == 1)
{
  match xs { [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, x)) [] => 0 }
}

fn binary_search_helper(n: Int, low: Int, high: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (low >= 0)
  requires (high >= low)
  requires ((low * low) <= n)
  requires (n < (high * high))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (n < ((result + 1) * (result + 1)))
  effects pure
  example (binary_search_helper(16, 0, 5) == 4)
{
  if ((high - low) <= 1) then low else if ((((low + high) / 2) * ((low + high) / 2)) <= n) then binary_search_helper(n, ((low + high) / 2), high) else binary_search_helper(n, low, ((low + high) / 2))
}

fn int_sqrt(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (n < ((result + 1) * (result + 1)))
  effects pure
  example (int_sqrt(0) == 0)
  example (int_sqrt(1) == 1)
  example (int_sqrt(15) == 3)
  example (int_sqrt(16) == 4)
  example (int_sqrt(17) == 4)
  example (int_sqrt(1000000) == 1000)
{
  binary_search_helper(n, 0, (n + 1))
}

fn run_length_at(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures ((result >= 1) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures forall j in 0..result: (xs[j] == xs[0])
  effects pure
  example (run_length_at([1, 1, 2]) == 2)
  example (run_length_at([2]) == 1)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [x, ..t] => match t { [] => 1 [y, ..tt] => if (x == y) then (1 + run_length_at(t)) else 1 } }
}

fn drop(xs: List[Int], n: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((n >= 0) and (n <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - n))
  effects pure
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3])
{
  if (n == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop(t, (n - 1)) }
}

fn longest_run_helper(xs: List[Int], max_so_far: Int) -> Int
  requires (max_so_far >= 1)
  ensures (result >= max_so_far)
  effects pure
  example (longest_run_helper([1, 1, 2, 2, 2], 1) == 3)
  example (longest_run_helper([], 1) == 1)
{
  match xs { [] => max_so_far [_, ..t] => longest_run_helper(drop(xs, run_length_at(xs)), if (run_length_at(xs) > max_so_far) then run_length_at(xs) else max_so_far) }
}

fn longest_run(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures ((result >= 1) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): (((i + result) <= len(xs)) and (forall j in i..(i + result): (xs[j] == xs[i])))
  ensures not (exists i in 0..len(xs): ((((i + result) + 1) <= len(xs)) and (forall j in i..((i + result) + 1): (xs[j] == xs[i]))))
  effects pure
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([7]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([1, 2, 3]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([5, 5, 1, 5, 5]) == 2)
  example (longest_run([4, 4, 4, 4]) == 4)
  example (longest_run([1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 3, 1]) == 4)
{
  longest_run_helper(xs, 1)
}

fn best_from(xs: List[Int], start: Int, end: Int, xs_len: Int, best: Int) -> Int
  requires ((((start >= 0) and (end >= start)) and (end <= xs_len)) and (xs_len == len(xs)))
  ensures (result >= best)
  effects pure
  example (best_from([1, 2, 3], 0, 1, 3, 0) == 6)
  example (best_from([1, 2, 3], 1, 2, 3, 0) == 5)
{
  if (end > xs_len) then best else if (end == xs_len) then if (sum_range(xs, start, end) > best) then sum_range(xs, start, end) else best else best_from(xs, start, (end + 1), xs_len, if (sum_range(xs, start, end) > best) then sum_range(xs, start, end) else best)
}

fn sum_range(xs: List[Int], i: Int, j: Int) -> Int
  requires (((i >= 0) and (i <= j)) and (j <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((i != j) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((j != (i + 1)) or (exists x in xs: (x == result)))
  effects pure
  example (sum_range([1, -2, 3, 4, -1], 2, 4) == 7)
  example (sum_range([1, -2, 3], 1, 1) == 0)
  example (sum_range([5, 6], 0, 2) == 11)
{
  if (i > 0) then match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => sum_range(t, (i - 1), (j - 1)) } else if (j == 0) then 0 else match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => (h + sum_range(t, 0, (j - 1))) }
}

fn list_len(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (list_len([1, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (list_len([]) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + list_len(t)) }
}

fn search_all(xs: List[Int], pos: Int, xs_len: Int, best: Int) -> Int
  requires (((pos >= 0) and (pos <= xs_len)) and (xs_len == len(xs)))
  requires forall i in 0..pos: forall j in (i + 1)..(xs_len + 1): (sum_range(xs, i, j) <= best)
  requires ((best > 0) or (pos == 0))
  requires exists x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures (result > 0)
  ensures forall i in pos..xs_len: forall j in (i + 1)..(xs_len + 1): (sum_range(xs, i, j) <= result)
  effects pure
  example (search_all([1, -2, 3, 4, -1], 0, 5, 0) == 7)
  example (search_all([2, 2, -5, 1], 0, 4, 0) == 4)
  example (search_all([-3, 5, -10], 0, 3, 0) == 5)
{
  if (pos == xs_len) then best else search_all(xs, (pos + 1), xs_len, best_from(xs, pos, (pos + 1), xs_len, best))
}

fn max_subarray(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires exists x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): exists j in (i + 1)..(len(xs) + 1): (sum_range(xs, i, j) == result)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): forall j in (i + 1)..(len(xs) + 1): (sum_range(xs, i, j) <= result)
  ensures (result > 0)
  effects pure
  example (max_subarray([1, -2, 3, 4, -1]) == 7)
  example (max_subarray([2, 2, -5, 1]) == 4)
  example (max_subarray([-3, 5, -10]) == 5)
{
  match xs { [h, ..t] => search_all(xs, 0, list_len(xs), 0) [] => 0 }
}

fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires sorted(xs)
  requires sorted(ys)
  ensures sorted(result)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall x in result: (count(result, x) == (count(xs, x) + count(ys, x)))
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == (count(xs, x) + count(ys, x)))
  ensures forall y in ys: (count(result, y) == (count(xs, y) + count(ys, y)))
  effects pure
  example (merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9])
  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([5, 6], []) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
  example (merge_sorted([1, 2, 3], [7, 8]) == [1, 2, 3, 7, 8])
  example (merge_sorted([-3, 0, 10], [-5, 4]) == [-5, -3, 0, 4, 10])
  example (merge_sorted([1, 3], [1, 2]) == [1, 1, 2, 3])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [x, ..xs_rest] => match ys { [] => xs [y, ..ys_rest] => if (x <= y) then ([x] ++ merge_sorted(xs_rest, ys)) else ([y] ++ merge_sorted(xs, ys_rest)) } }
}

fn count_occurrences(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == count(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (count_occurrences([1, 2, 2, 3], 2) == 2)
  example (count_occurrences([1, 2, 2, 3], 1) == 1)
  example (count_occurrences([1, 2, 2, 3], 4) == 0)
  example (count_occurrences([], 1) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then (1 + count_occurrences(t, x)) else count_occurrences(t, x) }
}

fn find_max_freq(xs: List[Int], current_best: Int, remaining: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, current_best)
  requires forall y in remaining: contains(xs, y)
  ensures contains(xs, result)
  ensures forall y in xs: (count(xs, y) <= count(xs, result))
  effects pure
  example (find_max_freq([1, 2, 2, 3], 1, [2, 2, 3]) == 2)
  example (find_max_freq([5], 5, []) == 5)
  example (find_max_freq([4, 7, 7, 4, 7], 4, [7, 7, 4, 7]) == 7)
  example (find_max_freq([-1, -1, 0], -1, [-1, 0]) == -1)
{
  match remaining { [] => current_best [h, ..t] => if (count_occurrences(xs, h) > count_occurrences(xs, current_best)) then find_max_freq(xs, h, t) else find_max_freq(xs, current_best, t) }
}

fn most_frequent(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((len(xs) == 0) or (exists x in xs: forall y in xs: ((y == x) or (count(xs, x) > count(xs, y)))))
  ensures ((len(xs) == 0) == (result == None))
  ensures ((len(xs) == 0) or (exists x in xs: ((result == Some(x)) and (forall y in xs: (count(xs, y) <= count(xs, x))))))
  effects pure
  example (most_frequent([1, 2, 2, 3]) == Some(2))
  example (most_frequent([]) == None)
  example (most_frequent([5]) == Some(5))
  example (most_frequent([4, 7, 7, 4, 7]) == Some(7))
  example (most_frequent([-1, -1, 0]) == Some(-1))
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => Some(find_max_freq(xs, h, t)) }
}

fn nth_ok(xs: List[Int], i: Int, r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or ((r == None) == (i >= len(xs))))
  effects pure
  example (nth_ok([5, 6, 7], 1, Some(6)) == true)
  example (nth_ok([5, 6, 7], 1, Some(7)) == false)
  example (nth_ok([5, 6, 7], 3, None) == true)
  example (nth_ok([5, 6, 7], 3, Some(7)) == false)
  example (nth_ok([5, 6, 7], 0, None) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => (r == None) [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then (r == Some(h)) else nth_ok(t, (i - 1), r) }
}

fn nth(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures nth_ok(xs, i, result)
  effects pure
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 1) == Some(6))
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 3) == None)
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 0) == Some(5))
  example (nth([], 0) == None)
{
  match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => if (i == 0) then Some(h) else nth(t, (i - 1)) }
}

fn pow_ref(b: Int, e: Int) -> Int
  requires (e >= 0)
  ensures ((e != 0) or (result == 1))
  ensures ((e != 1) or (result == b))
  effects pure
  example (pow_ref(2, 0) == 1)
  example (pow_ref(2, 10) == 1024)
  example (pow_ref(-3, 3) == -27)
{
  if (e == 0) then 1 else (b * pow_ref(b, (e - 1)))
}

fn power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 1)
  ensures (result == pow_ref(base, exp))
  ensures ((exp != 1) or (result == base))
  effects pure
  example (power(2, 10) == 1024)
  example (power(-3, 3) == -27)
  example (power(5, 1) == 5)
  example (power(0, 4) == 0)
  example (power(-2, 4) == 16)
{
  pow_ref(base, exp)
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): (result[i] == xs[((i + k) % len(xs))])
  effects pure
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4, 1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([], 0) == [])
  example (rotate_left([5, 6, 7], 2) == [7, 5, 6])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => rotate_left((t ++ [h]), (k - 1)) }
}

fn size(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures (result == len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (size([]) == 0)
  example (size([5, 6]) == 2)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [_, ..t] => (1 + size(t)) }
}

fn has(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Bool
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures (result == contains(xs, v))
  effects pure
  example (has([1, 2], 2) == true)
  example (has([1, 2], 3) == false)
{
  match xs { [] => false [h, ..t] => ((h == v) or has(t, v)) }
}

fn count_greater(xs: List[Int], v: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((result >= 0) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((result == 0) or (exists x in xs: (x > v)))
  ensures ((result > 0) or (forall x in xs: (x <= v)))
  effects pure
  example (count_greater([3, 9, 1], 3) == 1)
  example (count_greater([3, 9, 1], 9) == 0)
  example (count_greater([], 0) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => ((if (h > v) then 1 else 0) + count_greater(t, v)) }
}

fn is_second_largest(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((true == true) or result)
  effects pure
  example (is_second_largest([3, 9, 1], Some(3)) == true)
  example (is_second_largest([3, 9, 1], Some(1)) == false)
  example (is_second_largest([3, 9, 1], Some(9)) == false)
  example (is_second_largest([3, 9, 1], None) == false)
  example (is_second_largest([4], None) == true)
  example (is_second_largest([4], Some(4)) == false)
{
  match r { None => (size(xs) < 2) Some(v) => (has(xs, v) and (count_greater(xs, v) == 1)) }
}

fn find_second(original: List[Int], remaining: List[Int], max1: Int, max2: Int) -> Int
  requires (((len(original) >= 2) and distinct(original)) and (max1 > max2))
  requires (contains(original, max1) and contains(original, max2))
  requires forall x in remaining: contains(original, x)
  ensures (contains(original, result) and (count_greater(original, result) == 1))
  effects pure
  example (find_second([3, 9, 1], [1], 9, 3) == 3)
  example (find_second([1, 2], [2], 2, 1) == 1)
  example (find_second([5, 4, 3, 2], [3, 2], 5, 4) == 4)
{
  match remaining { [] => max2 [h, ..t] => if (h > max1) then find_second(original, t, h, max1) else if ((h > max2) and (h != max1)) then find_second(original, t, max1, h) else find_second(original, t, max1, max2) }
}

fn second_largest(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures is_second_largest(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (second_largest([3, 9, 1]) == Some(3))
  example (second_largest([4]) == None)
  example (second_largest([]) == None)
  example (second_largest([1, 2]) == Some(1))
  example (second_largest([5, 4, 3, 2]) == Some(4))
{
  match xs { [] => None [a, ..t] => match t { [] => None [b, ..rest] => if (a > b) then Some(find_second(xs, rest, a, b)) else if (b > a) then Some(find_second(xs, rest, b, a)) else None } }
}

fn zip_sum(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([-1, 5], [1, -5]) == [0, 0])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [x, ..xt] => match ys { [] => [] [y, ..yt] => ([(x + y)] ++ zip_sum(xt, yt)) } }
}
